heading: Iconic <highlight>Places</highlight> to Explore
subtitle: From clifftop temples to hidden beaches — discover the spots that make Bali & Nusa Penida unforgettable.

destinations.title: Kelingking Beach
destinations.description: The iconic T-Rex shaped cliff plunging into turquoise waters. One of the most photographed spots in all of Indonesia — the viewpoint alone is worth the trip to Nusa Penida.

destinations.title: Tegalalang Rice Terrace
destinations.description: Walk through centuries-old cascading rice paddies surrounded by coconut palms and misty jungle. A living canvas of Bali's agricultural heritage and a UNESCO-recognized cultural landscape.

destinations.title: Uluwatu Temple
destinations.description: Perched 70 meters above the Indian Ocean on dramatic sea cliffs, this 11th-century temple offers breathtaking sunset views and the legendary Kecak Fire Dance performance.

destinations.title: Tanah Lot Temple
destinations.description: Bali's most photographed sea temple sits on a rock formation surrounded by crashing waves. At sunset, the silhouette creates one of the most magical scenes in Southeast Asia.

destinations.title: Tirta Empul
destinations.description: A sacred water temple where crystal-clear spring water flows through ancient stone fountains. Visitors can participate in the traditional Balinese purification ritual — a deeply spiritual experience.

destinations.title: Lempuyang Temple
destinations.description: The famous Gates of Heaven frame a perfect view of Mount Agung, Bali's highest and most sacred volcano. An early morning visit rewards you with misty, ethereal views.
